A seat is yours

A seat on repose is held for you until 30 September 2026 at 14:00 UTC. Choose a plan before then and it is yours. Seven days are free, with a card at checkout.

If the hold runs out, the seat goes to the next person and you go back on the list.

Choose a plan: https://repose.herakraft.co/billing
